trigger.new_authoring_commit_message: Contains [skip ci] to suppress push/pull_request workflows for this development-only event.
job_admission: event.ref is the single pre-reviewed new branch
event commit/tree and all controller/input pins match the request

execution.scope: New independent authoring DEVELOPMENT revision; never a terminal result for the previous desktop operation.
execution.initial_work: Only the frozen generator, source AST and unchanged profile/cap controls.
execution.later_native_compile: Separate explicit step only after binding actual B3 bytes, original profile and complete original observations; no host substitute.
execution.python: Pin a complete version and record actual executable/stdlib identity; do not infer equality from 3.14 alone.
execution.checkout: Exact event commit; persist-credentials false; no ambient repository credentials inherited by author child.
execution.ownership: Reuse reviewed owner and existing authoring 180-second inner / 240-second outer limits; no cold execution or altered cold budget.

publication.scope: Only a fixed new evidence branch; no default, PR, old evidence or product ref update.
publication.permissions: contents: write only for the evidence publisher job, remaining GitHub token permissions none.
publication.token: Supply only to the final if:always publisher step. Do not print headers, environment tokens or secret-bearing URLs.
publication.raw_custody: Original HIA/source/report text as exact UTF-8; other binary or oversized files as fixed 49152-byte raw chunks encoded to ASCII base64, plus full path/type/mode/size/SHA256/Git-blob manifest.
publication.failure_custody: Publish stdout, stderr, original owner/report and partial generated files even on failure. Publication success does not convert authoring failure to success.
publication.ref_semantics: POST git/refs create-only to the predeclared ref. An existing ref is only read to compare with the one expected commit; never PATCH/force. An uncertain response is reconciled, never assigned a new ref.
publication.tree_allowlist: Parent is the reviewed authoring source commit; tree changes only under a predeclared experiments output prefix; all previous leaves verified unchanged.
publication.readback: Independently read complete new commit/tree and every output blob; decode chunk sequence and compare full original byte digests.
publication.no_recursive_run: No PR or dispatch is created; ordinary push/create events made with repository GITHUB_TOKEN do not recursively run workflows.
publication.fallback: if:always artifact is an additional backup. If policy rejects contents write, retain PUBLICATION_HOLD and do not introduce a new token or broaden permissions.

remaining_pins: Exact authoring source/control/request commit and hashes
Complete Python version and checkout/setup/upload action SHAs
Allowed output inventory/capacity and deterministic publication metadata
